inputs: Only four original released 211-Angstrom images per forecast. All new candidates and controls have identical fitting/evaluation rows and original fit-block labels. No wind-speed history as a predictor, recurrence data, EVE or external imagery.
development: Four training-side folds: for each fold in the bank, fit the other three and evaluate that fold. Per-split image centering, normalization and scalers use fitting folds only. Same original training offsets6..18/evaluation offsets6..19. Fold5 bytes are hash-checked and discarded without parsing or retaining them in the development worker. Do not read/import F1 final results, released WindNet forecasts, old full-data bundles, or test-case analyses in development. Hypotheses derive only from training-side outcomes and source/metric definitions. Earlier published test scores are already known to this conversation and cannot be made unseen.
final: Only after strict training-side adoption and a stability check, freeze exact source/recipe/data identities, then make one separate matched historical five-fold evaluation. No test feedback may determine model choice or a subsequent hypothesis. Report continued prior exposure and sequential-testing limits; never call this a fresh blind confirmation.
metrics: Mean fold RMSE km/s, Fisher-z averaged fold Pearson r (paper aggregation), arithmetic mean r also disclosed, reduced chi-square using original target sigma, mean fold HSE threat score using original HSEcalc. MAE and 500/600 threshold metrics secondary. Report undefined metrics explicitly. Paper baseline distinct from any modern port.
success: Require a candidate to beat BOTH training-side controls on all four aggregated metrics: mean-fold RMSE <=.99*the lower control RMSE; Fisher r >=the higher control r+.005; mean reduced chi-square <=.995*the lower control chi-square; mean original HSE threat score >=the higher control TS+.02. Undefined scores fail. Record all candidates, metrics and ablations; no single-metric promotion.
stopping: Continue inside the original US$5 cumulative estimated Runpod envelope; prior phase conservative estimate US$0.50672. Track live worker cost and download evidence before deleting only resources created for this phase.
prior_exposure: Published historical holdout scores were already in this conversation before this request. This campaign is prospectively sealed against further test feedback, not a pristine blind or fresh confirmatory study.
publication: User explicitly authorized public RogNet campaign/experiments and commits pushed to GitHub. Dashboard remains owner-private by default.
